title: Vampire Relationships
description:
A relationship map for vampire chronicles, drawn on its own scene. Characters are tokens shown as portraits; bonds between them (sire and childe, regnant and ghoul, allies, rivals, debts...) are coloured, labelled lines.

Who sees what follows Foundry ownership: a player only meets the characters they have ownership of, and each bond has its own audience. Built for the Vampire the Requiem 2E system, and usable with any other.
